questions.enonce_markdown: The value of an exterior angle.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Let the exterior angle be $e$. Then the interior angle is $2e$.

Interior and exterior angles at a vertex lie on a straight line: $2e + e = 180^\circ$, so $3e=180^\circ$ and $e = 60^\circ$.

**Exterior angle $=60^\circ$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The number of sides of the polygon.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The exterior angles of any polygon sum to $360^\circ$, and in a regular polygon they are all equal:

$n = \dfrac{360^\circ}{60^\circ} = 6$.

**The polygon has 6 sides.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Name the polygon. *[6 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
A regular polygon with 6 sides is a **regular hexagon**.

(Check: each interior angle is $120^\circ = 2\times 60^\circ$.)
